question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**towards**" means in the direction of someone or something.
 
• In the context of the sentence,** "His back was towards me"** indicates the position and direction the person's back was facing.
 
• The other options: "**below**", "**beyond**", and "**above**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** His back was towards__ me, and he had his arms folded, and was nodding forward, heavy with sleep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Below (नीचे)**: means at a lower level or layer.
 
• **Beyond (परे)**: means at or to the further side of.
 
• **Above (ऊपर)**: means at a higher level or layer.
